बॉलीवुड की मशहूर स्टंटवुमन गीता टंडन ने रियलिटी शो India Ke Top 1% की टीम पर बदसलूकी के गंभीर आरोप लगाए हैं! 😱

गीता टंडन का दावा है कि उन्हें और उनके बेटे को Star Plus और JioHotstar के शो पर अनपेड गेस्ट के रूप में बुलाया गया था। इसके लिए उन्होंने अपने दिन की शूटिंग छोड़ी और बेटे को Goa से वापस बुलाया।

गीता के पोस्ट के मुताबिक, दोपहर 12:30 PM से रात 9:15 PM तक, यानी लगभग 9 घंटे उन्हें और उनके बेटे को एक टेंट में बिना किसी अपडेट के बैठाकर रखा गया।

उनका आरोप है कि जब उन्होंने सवाल किया तो प्रोडक्शन मैनेजर Jaydeep ने कहा कि वे बिना साइन किए नहीं जा सकते।

गीता ने अनिल कपूर, Farah Khan और Banijay Asia का ध्यान खींचते हुए कहा कि कैमरे के पीछे काम करने वाले आर्टिस्ट्स भी बराबरी के सम्मान के हकदार हैं। फिलहाल इस मामले पर मेकर्स या हॉस्ट्स की तरफ से कोई जवाब नहीं आया है। 🎬

क्या आपको लगता है कि इंडस्ट्री में बिहाइंड द सीन काम करने वाले कलाकारों को सही सम्मान नहीं मिलता? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.text:
In a strongly worded social media post, the stunt professional recounts being invited for an unpaid appearance, alleging that the team was disrespectful.
Bollywood stuntwoman and stunt director Geeta Tandon has called out the production team of India Ke Top 1% over what she described as a deeply disappointing experience on the sets of the Star Plus reality show. In a detailed social media post, Tandon alleged that she and her son were made to wait for nearly nine hours despite being invited to appear on the show as guests. She also addressed host Anil Kapoor, Farah Khan and the show's production company, Banijay Asia, raising concerns about the way they were allegedly treated.
Hosted by Anil Kapoor, India Ke Top 1% is a game show featuring around 100 participants competing for prize money of up to Rs. 1 crore. The show airs on Star Plus and also streams on JioHotstar. Tandon said she had agreed to appear on the programme without any payment, believing it would offer her some visibility. However, she alleged that the experience left her feeling disrespected.
Opening her post, she wrote, “20 years in this industry. And yesterday, I was reminded how little respect people working behind the scenes are sometimes given.” Explaining how she came to be on the sets, Tandon said, “My name is Geeta Tandon. I have worked in the film and television industry for over two decades, as a body double for some of the biggest actresses in the country and as a stunt director. I have dedicated years of my life to this profession, often working behind the camera, and I have always taken immense pride in what I do. Yesterday, I was invited to appear as a guest on the show India Ke Top 1%, to interact with Anil Kapoor, along with my son.”
According to Tandon, the production team had repeatedly followed up with her for the appearance. She claimed that she gave up a day's work and even called her son back from Goa specifically for the shoot. Recalling the events of the day, she said she reached the set at 12:30 PM and was informed that her segment would be filmed within a few hours. However, the wait allegedly continued through the day, with little communication from the team. She further alleged that she and her son were made to sit in a tent without proper updates or clarity about when they would be called. Tandon said that when she eventually confronted the production team, she was met with another response that she found unacceptable.
Recalling the exchange, she wrote, “The production manager, Jaydeep, responded, ‘If they want to leave, let them leave. But they can't leave without signing.’ Signing what? And why should anyone be made to feel that they cannot leave after being kept waiting all day?” Tandon claimed that she and her son eventually left the set at 9:15 PM, after spending nearly nine hours there. Emphasising that the appearance was unpaid, she said the least she expected was basic courtesy and respect for their time.
Addressing Banijay Asia, Anil Kapoor and Farah Khan, she clarified that she did not know how much they were aware of the alleged incident and was not suggesting that they had personally instructed anyone to treat them that way. However, she wanted them to know about the experience of guests invited to the show.
Concluding her post, Tandon highlighted the larger issue of how professionals working behind the scenes are treated in the entertainment industry. She wrote, “The person standing behind the camera deserves the same dignity as the person standing in front of it.”
She also dedicated her post to stunt professionals, junior artists, body doubles, technicians, background performers and other guests, reiterating that respect should not depend on someone's celebrity status.
At the time of writing, the allegations shared by Geeta Tandon had not been accompanied by a response from the show's production team, Banijay Asia, Anil Kapoor or Farah Khan.
